_comment: Minimal intake for ID_STUDY=2 ('Análise de Estudo 2 — Teste de Burnout'). This study was created WITHOUT running GDX_SKILL_NEW_STUDY's interview or GDX_SKILL_RECORD_NEW_STUDY, because it introduces no new instrument -- it reuses the existing Maslach Burnout Inventory - Student Survey catalog entry (ID_INSTRUMENT=9) verbatim (see 2.relational.model.psychometrics/samples.SQL/manual_load_study2_burnout_test.sql). This file exists ONLY so --study burnout-test-2's slug/title resolution works for GDX_SKILL_EXPORT_NEW_STUDY (and any other --study-scoped skill later) -- it deliberately omits the constructs/variables/items GDX_SKILL_RECORD_NEW_STUDY would need, since none of that needs creating: the instrument, its items and its alternatives already exist in GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT/GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT_ITEM/GDX_PSY_ITEM_ALTERNATIVE. name/version below are copied verbatim from that existing catalog row.

study.title: Análise de Estudo 2 — Teste de Burnout
study.objective: Identificar quando/se uma pessoa está em estado de estresse (burnout).

instruments.name: Maslach Burnout Inventory - Student Survey (hypothesis - unconfirmed)
